columns.name: player_height_in_cm
columns.description: Height of the player in cm

columns.name: num_games_played
columns.description: Number of games played by the player, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: diff_goals_bewteen_Rs_and_Pf
columns.description: The difference in the number of goals the player scored during the regular season versus the playoffs, calculated as regular season minus playoffs. Leave it as NULL if any data is missing.

columns.name: total_penalty_minutes_season_1997_1998
columns.description: Total penalty minutes for the player during the 1997-1998 season, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: num_goals_for_Rimouski_Oceanic_in_playoff
columns.description: Number of goals scored by the player for the Rimouski Oceanic during the playoffs, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: player_BMI
columns.description: Body Mass Index of the player
